import sys

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
T = int(input[0])
index = 1

for _ in range(T):
    n = int(input[index])
    a = list(map(int, input[index + 1:index + 1 + n]))
    correct = True
    for i in range(n):
        if abs(a[i] - (i + 1)) > 1:
            correct = False
            break
    print("YES" if correct else "NO")
    index += 1 + n
